purpose: Give a comparison-page visitor the answer in four rows: a three-column table that sets Reevo against one named competitor on best-for, system of record, AI capability and ideal team, so the decision is visible before any longer argument.

behaviour.note: One template serves 7 competitors (apollo, attio, fireflies, gong, hubspot, outreach, salesforce); only the competitor name, logo and the four rows change. Unknown slugs fall back to the gong data.
Always exactly 4 rows in the same label order across all 7 competitors: best for, system of record, AI capabilities, ideal team.

Column 1 (feature) has a visually hidden header. Column 2 header is the Reevo wordmark (23px high, inline SVG); column 3 header is the competitor logo (20px by 76px box, single colour, muted foreground). The competitor logo is an inline SVG built from stored path data with fill currentColor.
Rows alternate gray-1 and background starting with gray-1. Column 1 cell text is bold. Cells are top-aligned and each column is one third wide.
Section sits on the gray-2 tint with the pattern-05 decorative strip. The section heading is the same sentence pattern on every competitor (Reevo vs. name: at a glance); the eyebrow label is fixed.

Deviation recorded in the source: the original's tables overflow the viewport below sm, so the clone adds overflow-x-clip to the section; on the phone layout the table bleeds 24px past the gutters (negative margin) instead of scrolling.

Text of the rows is competitor comparison copy written by the original author. It is not reproduced here; only the budgets are. Some Reevo cells are marketing claims and must be treated as fixed data per competitor, not free-authored.

themeDependency.how: Rendered in the default light scope on a gray-2 band; the header cells for Reevo and the competitor use the gray-3 tint with a translucent gray-4 border. It is not wrapped in a dark scope (contrast: the feature table further down is).

competitorName.note: Used in the section headline. Observed 1 word.

competitorLogo.note: Single-colour third-party logo shown in the column 3 header. Reuse the exact existing file only (inline path data in data/compare.js, standalone copy under public/assets/images/compare/logos/); never redraw.

label.note: Bold row label. Observed up to 5 words (one HubSpot label carries a bracketed acronym).

reevo.note: Reevo cell. Observed up to 12 words. Plain text.

competitor.note: Competitor cell. Observed up to 10 words. Plain text.

motion.reducedMotionNote: No animation or hover state in the table; the code has no prefers-reduced-motion handling.

changes.change: table extends 24px beyond each side gutter (negative horizontal margin) and the section clips horizontal overflow
table takes the full width of the content column
header cell padding 24px on all sides (from 20px vertical); body cell vertical padding 24px
header cell padding 32px; body cells 32px horizontal and 28px vertical
